description: Phase A deterministic demo set for the bos (new nature / forest planting) track. The zoekgebied itself is small (23.9 km²), so the scenarios probe its boundaries.

scenarios.name: Oude bosgroeiplaatsen treated as hard exclusion
scenarios.description: FR-B-03 (Waardevolle Houtopstanden — oude bosgroeiplaatsen, art. 6.13) is a conditional overlay in the baseline; this variant protects existing old-forest values by hard exclusion.

basis.provenanceNote: NC-B-03 (art. 6.13) conditions new planting on old-forest values in the baseline; this variant executes the protective reading as a hard exclusion.

scenarios.name: Zoekgebied expanded by a 1 km band
scenarios.description: Buffers the Groene contour zoekgebied (FR-B-01) outward by 1 km — a land-acquisition-budget thought experiment, explicitly hypothetical.

basis.rationale: The zoekgebied is a voluntary-conversion search area, not a boundary nature cannot cross; this hypothetical measures what a 1 km expansion band would add. No instrument text supports the 1 km figure.
basis.provenanceNote: NOT legally grounded: the zoekgebied (NC-B-01, art. 6.4 lid 1) is cited, the 1 km expansion is the scenario's own parameter.
